title.en: An Act Appropriating Certain Sums to be Paid as Compensation to the Children of the Late Representatives Lorenzo P. Ziga and Gregorio B. Tan
title.orig: An Act Appropriating Certain Sums to be Paid as Compensation to the Children of the Late Representatives Lorenzo P. Ziga and Gregorio B. Tan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1309_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sum of fifteen thousand four hundred eighty-one pesos and twenty-nine centavos is appropriated to be paid as compensation to the children of the late Representative Lorenzo P. Ziga, and the sum of fifteen thousand four hundred eighty-one pesos and twenty-nine centavos is appropriated to be paid as compensation to the children of the late Representative Gregorio B. Tan, both of whom died in line of duty. These amounts shall be exempt from all kinds of taxes.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1955.
